p.t: A Journey Through Yamaguchi’S Nature And Tourism
p.d: 2026. Explore Japan through nature in Yamaguchi, Honshu’s western tip. See Omijima from the sea, explore Akiyoshidai caves, experience samurai culture in Shimonoseki, and enjoy Hawaiian hula in Suo-Oshima.

2016, Episode 5. A staple meal for sumo wrestlers, is often filled with chicken for nutrition and symbolism. Chickens walk on two legs, making them a symbol of good luck, and chicken meatballs resemble the white markers used for sumo tournament wins.

2026. Relentless deforestation is pumping carbon dioxide into the atmosphere and fueling climate change, which in turn is causing further forest loss. We look at the efforts to break this damaging cycle. Hiroko Kuniya, Takeshige Morimoto.
